title: Distillation rate of W states from a Bell triangle
source: Eisert asks for the minimum total Bell-pair cost of forming W states asymptotically \sourcecite{ref:a1eea8-eisert01}{Eisert01} (Example 2.28). For this permutation-invariant target, the cost and the equal-edge rate ask the same question. A protocol using unequal numbers of pairs can be run on three blocks with cyclically permuted party roles, balancing the total consumption across the edges.
